title: BiobankSample
description: JSON Schema for a biobank sample management system tracking donors, biological samples, and aliquots.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for the biological sample.

donor_id.description: Reference to the donor who provided the sample.

aliquots.description: List of aliquots derived from this sample.

Donor.title: Donor
Donor.description: Information about the biological sample donor.

age.description: Age of the donor at the time of sample collection, in years.

diagnosis_code.description: ICD-10 diagnosis code associated with the donor at collection time.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for the biological sample.

donor_id.description: Foreign key to the donor record.

tissue_type.description: Type of biological tissue from which the sample was derived.

collection_date.description: ISO 8601 date on which the sample was collected.

volume_ml.description: Total volume of the sample in millilitres.

concentration_ug_ul.description: Nucleic acid or protein concentration in micrograms per microlitre.

purity_ratio_260_280.description: Absorbance ratio at 260/280 nm indicating nucleic acid purity.

integrity_number_rin.description: RNA Integrity Number (RIN) on a scale of 1-10.

Aliquot.title: Aliquot
Aliquot.description: A sub-division of a parent sample.

volume_ul.description: Volume of this aliquot in microlitres.

freeze_thaw_cycles.description: Number of freeze-thaw cycles the aliquot has undergone.

storage_location.description: Physical storage location identifier (freezer, rack, box, position).
